title: PM Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman Yojana (PMVKSY):
summary: PM Vishwakarma Kaushal Samman Yojana (PMVKSY): — Flagship scheme comprehensively covered in the Government Schemes Consolidated Masterfile.

blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Launched under the PM Vikas Yojana, is a central government initiative aimed at providing
financial and skill development support to traditional artisans and craftsmen.
 Financial Assistance: Rs. 3 lakh at 5% interest, with Rs. 1 lakh in the first installment (18
months) and Rs. 2 lakh in the second (30 months).
 Digital Transaction Incentive: Rs. 1 per transaction (up to Rs. 100/month)
 Eligibility: One artisan per family, age 18+, no other government loans in the last 5 years
 Verification: By Gram Panchayat, District Committee, and Screening Committee
 The scheme aims to enhance skills, provide financial support, and integrate artisans into the
MSME sector for better market access.
